carry_calibration.rule: Each target length preserves its source cel's visible proportion at the pilot's baked weapon-to-unarmed-body ratio: carry_scale = (pilot baked_length / body_height) * body_height / pilot source_length.

debug_stick.foot_anchor_semantics: Ready poses and locomotion share the torso axis at pivot x; feet cycle freely. Foot anchors follow the translated soles, with at most 3px run bob around the ground row. Attacks and unused legacy run cells retain their original registration.

body_registration.method: shirt back edge + 6px for run, shirt centroid for other ready poses

foot_planting.note: Attack frames (step1-step3: windup, contact, follow) plant the rear foot, including step3 contact and step3 follow (the reused step1 follow cel), so the foot stays planted through the recoil. Idle, run, and equip plant the body foot named by body_foot_targets, which already holds the run body steady; hurt uses the foot centre.
